correctness.rationale: For integer nodes a_0=0,a_j=k_j, the Hermite–Genocchi identity gives t^4 FT=[a_0,…,a_4]e^{tz} at t=-2πi. Contour partial fractions and integer-node e^{ta}=1 reduce this to a rational-coefficient polynomial in transcendental t, with its constant coefficient zero since denominator is O(z^-5). If one node uniquely maximizes multiplicity at M≥2, c_{a,M}=∏_{b≠a}(a-b)^-m_b is nonzero; only tied maximal partition of 5 with repeated nodes is (2,2,1), whose t-term coefficient is (a+b-2c)/[(a-b)^2(a-c)(b-c)]. Thus midpoint iff resonance and all-distinct zeros exhaust every partition. For d≤3 only tied case (2,2) produces 2/(a-b)^2≠0. Independent symbolic partial-fraction computations recovered zeros for nodes [0,0,1,2,2] and [0,1,1,-1,-1], and nonzero -t/6 for [0,0,1,2,3]. Normalization uses unnormalized Lebesgue measure on simplex (vol 1/24), negative exponential, and integer lattice only.
